title: Cloud resource catalog target — per-resource-type architecture for the full cloud-* substrate
purpose: Instantiates the Cloud Control Plane per-resource-type contract (quota_cost/billing_meters/audit_events/lifecycle_state/owner/tenant_account_project/region_cell/slo_tier/deletion_retention) for every cloud-* resource service. Each resource type is ORN-addressed, Cedar-gated, OTel-instrumented, billable, and actuated via OpenTofu/operator/Argo behind the control plane. Honest non-claim: target spec; cloud-* services remain metadata-only foundations until P-STRANGLE migrates each to live provisioning.

services.notes: identity substrate for all other resources (ADR-0244)
per-tenant DEK; no raw key material in metadata

services.actuation: Cluster API / EC2/OKE / serverless; Kata for tenant-untrusted (ADR-0338)
Postgres/Citus, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, Milvus, Valkey (workload-specific, not universal defaults)
services.notes: FORCE RLS + Citus distribution; tenant-cell partitioning

deployment_isolation.shared_cloud: logical: cell + Cedar + per-tenant encryption; multi-tenant resource cells
deployment_isolation.dedicated_cloud: physical: dedicated cell pinning + shuffle-shard per tenant

non_claims: Target spec only — enumerates resource types + their control-plane contract; does NOT implement any provider provisioning, live resource CRUD, OpenTofu plan/apply, operator/Cluster-API/Argo runtime, or persistence.
cloud-* services are metadata-only foundations today; live provisioning + measured SLO/DR/scale evidence are P-STRANGLE/P-PROD; all such claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.

cloud-compute.required_truth: The cloud-compute directory may exist for foundation/contract code, but directory presence must not be read as provider provisioning, live resource CRUD, tenant workload readiness, or hyperscaler feature-parity claim.
